name: checkpoint_flush_after
description: Number of pages written during a checkpoint after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk by the OS.
symptoms: High I/O latency spikes during checkpoints
Excessive dirty page accumulation in OS buffer cache
Checkpoint bloat leading to long recovery times
Inconsistent write throughput under heavy WAL load
tuning_tips: Increase cautiously (e.g., 64–128) on fast storage (NVMe/SSD) to smooth I/O; reduce or set to 0 on slow storage or when OS-level write coalescing is preferred. Monitor 'checkpoints_req' and 'buffers_checkpoint' metrics.
